title: Bessent PANICS as Bonds Collapse to 25 Year Low - Europe Just Confirmed the End Game
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: Bondholders lost ~-2%/yr over a decade; demand for Treasuries dropping; refinancing wave at 5.3% will balloon interest costs.
Either demand destruction lowers yields or Fed QE and the dollar collapses.
France has lost control of its bond market; euro at 17-month low; contagion risk to Italy and Spain.
ECB/Bundesbank voices urge diversifying reserves into gold.
Inflows into US equities inflate an AI bubble that will unravel if rates keep climbing.

calls.reason: Oil-driven inflation, huge deficits and $15T refinancing wall keep pushing yields up; no credible fiscal fix.
Bonds no longer a safe reserve; currency debasement; central banks urged to diversify into gold.
calls.quote: You cannot just rely on US bonds as your emergency backs stop anymore. You got to hold other things like gold

calls.reason: French bond rout and expected ECB rescue (rate cuts, QE or austerity) all negative for the euro.
calls.quote: whatever option Christine Lagard chooses, none of them are good for the currency

calls.reason: Equity inflows above 3% of GDP inflating an AI bubble vulnerable to higher rates.
calls.quote: It just inflates an even bigger bubble that will still unravel badly if interest rates keep climbing
